_doc: One row per deliverable (Excel_NAME = the GFIX-side job name, e.g. RJDSWM40). Built by gfixRecv.plan from the WBS rows the operator PICKS for the day (today / late / ahead sets; + mapping.xlsx rows dated today, for GFIX_TIME / FileCount; FileCount -1 = not known); the day-flows checkpoint into gift / track / logs / evidence / deliver and take only rows whose WORKDAY is today and whose hold is blank.
_doneFile_doc: a verdict column's doneFile is the phase's own record of a finished row: when the cell is blank but the file was written on or after the row's day, the menu offers to mark it ok before the phase runs again (10/20)

dashboard._doc: ebi status / ebi menu: the columns shown between the key and the verdict columns, in this order (else every non-key non-verdict column, as many as fit in 80 columns)
dashboard._dateColumn_doc: the row's day: when no row carries today's date, NEXT says run plan first (10/16: the earlier days' rows made it say track). WORKDAY since 10/20 (the day the plan gave the row; a row with a blank WORKDAY falls back to GFIX_DATE)

columns.name: GFIX_COUNTS
columns._doc: the counts of the Teams start message (e.g. 815件、46件) as gfixRecv.track first read them: a rerun with no message takes them from here, so the reply still carries the record counts (10/27)

columns.name: WORKDAY
columns._doc: the day the plan picked this row for (yyyy-MM-dd). The day phases take only today's rows (-AllDays for every day); GFIX_DATE stays the day the GFIX job ran

columns.name: hold
columns._doc: not blank = on hold, with the reason (HOST 待ち): every phase leaves the row out until it is cleared (menu h)

columns.name: GIFT_DATE
columns._doc: the day the GIFT job ran (mapping.xlsx M, GIFT実行日; plan copies it): gfixRecv.gift looks for the GIFT files around it

columns.name: GIFT_TIME
columns._doc: the GIFT run time (mapping.xlsx N, GIFT TIME); blank = gfixRecv.gift offers the whole day by hour

columns.name: gift
columns._doc: DATA/GIFT/<J> (or <W>) holds the GIFT files: gfixRecv.gift (found, or downloaded from the Jenkins list). needFiles: the menu's self check (k) says so when gift is ok, track is not, and none of these has a file

columns.name: review
columns._doc: gfixRecv.review (10/28): the book's self-review without Excel / Python (kernel/BookReview.ps1, the non-OCR checks of tools/review/check_book.py); deliver takes only rows whose review is ok
